summary: First auth-integration test pass for Wolfdynamic EAGS site. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass — health, admin login+cookies, wrong-password 401, /auth/me, logout, brute-force 429 on 6th, register (pending + cookies), duplicate 409, short-password 422, pending user portal 403, admin list users, approve→role change→login→portal 200, deactivate + self-deactivate 400, contact create (public), invalid email 4xx, unauth GET 401, admin GET list newest-first, mark-read as admin, mark-read as non-admin 403. Frontend: home shows required hero copy (INDIA'S FIRST / WING-IN-GROUND / CARGO VEHICLE.), nav-signin present, contact form submits and clears, /login redirects admin to /admin, admin dashboard shows inquiries and users tables (admin user visible), /register (logged out) creates pending user and redirects to /pending, pending user is blocked from /admin and /portal (both redirect to /pending), pending-logout works, logged-out /admin redirects to /login, admin sign-out clears session. Confidentiality check clean: no MEHAIR/Wow Ferries/rupee amounts/LOI names on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py seed_admin uses env ADMIN_PASSWORD default 'admin123' as fallback — fine because .env sets it, but a missing env var would silently seed a weak password. Consider raising if ADMIN_PASSWORD is unset.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Currently works because backend echoes '*' but for production set an explicit origin list. Recommend main agent tighten CORS_ORIGINS to the frontend URL.

server.py: /auth/logout requires auth (Depends get_current_user) — if a user's token has already expired, they get 401 on logout instead of a graceful cookie-clear. Consider making logout tolerant of unauthenticated calls.
sanitize_user is called on some already-projected docs (password_hash excluded at query) — harmless duplication but keeps behavior consistent.
test_credentials: Admin admin@wolfdynamics.in / Wolf#EAGS-2026! (works). Fresh test users created via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_-prefixed users created via /api/auth/register (approve/deactivate/portal/pending). Several TEST_ contact inquiries created and one marked read.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_contact.py — reuse for regression. Admin auth uses httpOnly cookies (SameSite=None; Secure); requests.Session handles them automatically. Brute-force test consumes an email; use fresh emails per run (helper _fresh_email). Contact endpoint is /api/contact (not /api/contact/inquiries). Data-testids on all critical UI verified working. Emergent Google Auth is NOT implemented — do not test.
